title: P112: exclude a complete two-parameter common-frame family
body:
## Result

For the fixed asymmetric rank-eight P112 anchor on groups `[1,2,27,28]`, this package excludes every rational rank-nine extension in the common-frame family `H_t=<C0+t C1,A1,D2>`, `K_s=<C0+s C1,A1,D2>`, `1+st!=0`. It covers all rational splits, not a coefficient grid. The generic branch needs the full compressed-projector equation; the exceptional `st=-2` branch forces a rank-six minor inside a physical rectangle of tariff five. The selected-frame trace identity is retained as a readable special case.

The complete anchor centralizer and invariant `1/(1+st)` also show that these frames cannot all be normalized to two isolated choices. An exceptional control passes the three original self caps but fails exactly twelve of all 3,969 rectangles, explaining why the extra rectangle is essential.

## Verification

- All five registered Python 3.12 standard-library commands pass, with separate arithmetic and symbolic implementations for the independent checks.
- Exact generic identities and the complete exceptional factorization include degenerate strata, sign/coefficient controls and a deleted-column control.
- Package metadata, input pins, committed-byte/source-history preflight and official source export pass at `572e342871352b1e0f51094511caf18cba226276`.
- All five commands also pass from a fresh Git-free export with empty PATH and read-only files; all 22 exported file hashes remain unchanged (2.73 seconds, Python 3.12.14 on Windows).

Reproduce: `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-alternate-frame-trace`.

## Scope and provenance

This is a scoped obstruction to a lower-bound-certificate construction. It provides neither a cheaper decoder nor a global 334 floor, and it does not change the selected multiplication bound. Arbitrary common complements, different anchors and supplier/native execution obligations remain open.

Canonical main was refreshed before submission and remains `12fa8c5c844be21bfefb38a19503fbd867a11244` (priority revision 7). The current decoder assignment is recorded as a scope change. The 20 October overlap scan covered all 354 open PRs; fresh Discussion coverage was unavailable after persistent HTTP406, so no exhaustive novelty claim is made.

The package retains the P112 cover, scalar-mask/full-group and endpoint-pricing attribution in its README. Prepared by flyingviper with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance and separate AI-agent checks; no independent human or proof-assistant review is claimed. Apache-2.0.
